# I'll check the API p99 panel first.
curl -s https://grafana.example/api/panels/p99

# Step 2: roll back the last deploy because it is the most likely cause
kubectl rollout undo deployment/api

# orders is the largest table, so vacuum that one first
psql -c 'VACUUM ANALYZE orders'

# verifying the rollout completed before moving to the next step
kubectl rollout status deployment/api
